description: java.util.PriorityQueue(comparator) as QueueActor uses it. Elements are [id, key, eq]: the comparator compares key (Integer.compare), equals/hashCode use eq only (marathon's Test equals by name, so a queue holds equal copies), id tells copies apart. Each step lists the comparator calls it made and the backing array after it.

schema.steps: list of {op, args, result, cmp, heap}
schema.steps[].op: offer | poll | peek | remove | removeAll | addAll | iterator | clear
schema.steps[].args: offer: [item]; addAll: [items]; remove: probe [id, key, eq] (matched by eq); removeAll: probes in a LinkedHashSet; others: []
schema.steps[].result: offer/addAll/remove/removeAll: boolean; poll/peek: id or null; iterator: ids in order
schema.steps[].cmp: comparator calls during the step as [left id, right id, sign of the result]
schema.steps[].heap: ids in the backing array order (= iteration order) after the step
